hints.title: Matrix Dimensions
hints.text: First compute the height of the tree. The matrix dimensions are m equals height plus one, and n equals two to the power of m minus one.

hints.title: Recursive Coordinate Placement
hints.text: Place the root at row zero and column n minus one divided by two. Pass row and column boundaries down recursive calls.

hints.title: Child Offset Computation
hints.text: A node placed at row r and column c positions its left child at row r plus one and column c minus two to the power of height minus r minus one, and right child with the addition.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Compute tree height first, pre-allocate matrix, then fill node coordinates via recursive placement.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Constructing rows dynamically without precomputing height misaligns column offsets.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pre-allocating the m x n grid allows direct coordinate indexing in O(1) per node.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Compute tree height with DFS, initialize matrix with empty strings, and place nodes using recursive offset formula.
